convention.variables: dual x, theta and spinor-helicity variables

generalized_R.name: R_{n;b1a1;...;brar;ab}
generalized_R.xi: <xi|=<n| x_{n b1} x_{b1 a1} x_{a1 b2} ... x_{br ar}
generalized_R.boundary_lower: when a=L replace <L-1| by <n|x_{n l1}x_{l1 l2}...
